description: Stores the history of inventory movements, including item quantities, valuation, warehouses, and the transactions that created them.

fields.description: Provides the details of each inventory movement recorded in the stock ledger.
fields.label: Stock Movement Details

fields.description: The date on which the inventory movement was recorded.
fields.label: Posting Date

fields.description: Select the inventory item involved in this stock movement.
fields.label: Item

fields.description: Select the warehouse where the inventory movement occurred.
fields.label: Warehouse

fields.description: The quantity added to or removed from the warehouse. Positive values increase stock, while negative values decrease stock.
fields.label: Actual Quantity

fields.description: The valuation rate per unit used to calculate the inventory value for this movement.
fields.label: Valuation Rate

fields.description: The total inventory value of this movement, calculated from the quantity and valuation rate.
fields.label: Stock Value

fields.description: The type of document that generated this stock movement, such as a Stock Entry.
fields.label: Voucher Type

fields.description: The reference number of the document that generated this stock movement.
fields.label: Voucher Number

name: Stock Ledger Entry
